incidents.name: EST/BNBDeposit skim desync
incidents.notes: A 1-EST transfer into EST's BNBDeposit contract desyncs its internal accounting, after which a loop of EST transfers to the pair plus skim() into BNBDeposit let the attacker withdraw far more than the 30 max-size deposits it had made.
